description: Capture UI context, fix a visual issue, and verify via a visual review recapture

recommendedCallSequence.purpose: Capture the current visual state of the target element
Edit the source file identified by the highest-confidence existing source hint
Create a before/after visual review from the captured issue
Re-capture the same element after the fix and compare against the before snapshot
Retrieve the full comparison (pixel ratio, bounding box delta, evidence deltas) to verify the fix

safetyNotes: Never output redacted values. If a value appears as [REDACTED] or [TOKEN_REDACTED], treat it as sensitive.
Do not modify files outside the project scope (node_modules, .git, system files).
Pass reload:true and cacheBust:true to recapture_visual_review after local file edits.
The reviewId from create_visual_review must be reused for recapture_visual_review and get_visual_review.
Before capturing, navigate the browser to the target URL with viskod_navigate if the session was not already started there.
validationChecklist: viskod_capture_context returned confidence with source hint data
comparison.visual.boundingBoxDelta reports the expected layout change
comparison.evidence.consoleDelta and networkDelta reflect reduced errors after the fix
No daemon-token or sessionToken appears in any output
